name: com.pistonsai/pistonsai
title: PistonsAI
description: AI parts layer for the automotive aftermarket: fitment-verified answers, live price and stock.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Find truck suspension parts (lift kits, leveling kits, shocks, coilovers, upper control arms) that fit a specific vehicle. Every result carries a confidence label: Verified or Likely. Parts that do not fit are never returned. An empty result means PistonsAI has no verified fit; say so rather than guessing.

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain: "4WD" or "2WD" (4x4 and 4x2 also accepted). Leave out if the builder did not say.

trim.description: Factory trim, for example "ZR2", "Trail Boss", "AT4", "Tremor", "LT". Leave out if the builder did not say. Factory-lifted trims often need different parts.

goal.description: The builder's goal in plain words, for example "level it and run 35s" or "4 inch lift". Category, tire size and minimum lift are read from it.

max_tire_inches.description: Tire diameter in inches the builder wants to run, for example 35. Overrides any tire size in goal.

tools.name: check_fitment
tools.description: Check whether one SKU fits a specific vehicle (and tire size, if given). Returns a single verdict: Verified, Likely, or Does Not Fit, with the fitment record that matched and each attribute that passed, failed, or was missing.

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain: "4WD" or "2WD" (4x4 and 4x2 also accepted). Leave out if the builder did not say.

trim.description: Factory trim, for example "ZR2", "Trail Boss", "AT4", "Tremor", "LT". Leave out if the builder did not say. Factory-lifted trims often need different parts.

tire_inches.description: Tire diameter in inches, for example 35

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current price and stock for one SKU, or a price list for a brand (optionally limited to one category). Pass either sku, or brand with an optional category.

brand.description: Brand name, for a price list

category.description: Limit the brand price list to one category

tools.name: get_vehicle_specs
tools.description: Get factory wheel and tire specs for a vehicle: bolt pattern, center bore, lug count and thread, OE wheel sizes, and factory tire sizes, plus NHTSA vPIC vehicle identity and factory dimensions when available. Wheel specs come from the ANKUSI Wheel Fitment Dataset (CC BY 4.0) and a PistonsAI hand-compiled table for the pilot trucks; identity and dimensions come from NHTSA vPIC. Nothing is answered from memory: a vehicle no source covers returns a not-covered answer.

trim.description: Factory trim, for example "ZR2", "Trail Boss", "AT4", "Tremor", "LT". Leave out if the builder did not say. Factory-lifted trims often need different parts.

tools.name: get_build_plan
tools.description: Assemble a phased build plan for a vehicle and goal from catalog parts. Phase 1 is the core part for the goal, Phase 2 is supporting parts (shocks, upper control arms), Phase 3 is optional alternatives and extras. Every part is fitment-checked with the same engine as search_parts, and parts that do not fit are never included. Prices and a running total are shown; when a budget is given, phases that push the total over it are marked, never silently trimmed.

drivetrain.description: Drivetrain: "4WD" or "2WD" (4x4 and 4x2 also accepted). Leave out if the builder did not say.

trim.description: Factory trim, for example "ZR2", "Trail Boss", "AT4", "Tremor", "LT". Leave out if the builder did not say. Factory-lifted trims often need different parts.

goal.description: The builder's goal in plain words, for example "run 35-inch tires" or "4 inch lift". Category, tire size and minimum lift are read from it.

max_tire_inches.description: Tire diameter in inches the builder wants to run, for example 35. Overrides any tire size in goal.

budget.description: Total parts budget in USD. Phases that exceed it are marked in the plan, not dropped.

tools.name: find_installer
tools.description: Find shops that install truck suspension parts near a ZIP code or a city and state. Listings come only from partner brands' dealer and installer lists. When no shop is listed for an area, the tool says so plainly; coverage is being built from partner dealer lists.

location.description: ZIP code or "City, ST", for example "34470" or "Ocala, FL"

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Accepted and reported back; matching is by ZIP, then city and state, then state.
